basic_details.job_title: ICFRE-RFRI Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 8 Junior Project Fellow, Project Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: The ICFRE-Rain Forest Research Institute holds a walk-in interview on 10 November 2026 from 9.30 am onwards at the institute in Jorhat (Deovan, Sotai, Jorhat-785010, Assam). Candidates must report between 9.30 am and 10.30 am. The institute will engage 4 Junior Project Fellows (JPF) at Rs. 24,000/- + HRA as admissible per month and 4 Project Assistants (PA) at Rs. 22,000/- per month (Fixed), on a purely contractual basis under a consultancy project.

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: The ICFRE-Rain Forest Research Institute is a unit of the Indian Council of Forestry Research and Education under the Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change, Government of India, located at Deovan, Sotai, Jorhat in Assam. This is a government institute. The posts are for a consultancy project funded by the National Highways & Infrastructure Development Corporation Ltd. (NHIDCL).

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Both posts are for the project "Enumeration and Economic Valuation of Standing Vegetation within the Silchar NHIDCL Project Area for Compensation against Land Acquisition". The project is described as "Initially for two months". Desirable for JPF: working experiences in forest and plant identification. No desirable qualification is printed for the Project Assistant post. For the full discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

rows.qualification: Essential: First class M. Sc. Degree in Forestry/ Botany/ Ecology/ Life Science/ Geography/ Agriculture
Essential: First class Bachelor Degree in Forestry/ Botany/ Zoology/ Geography/ Agriculture

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The notice asks candidates to submit the following on the day of the interview, between 9.30 am and 10.30 am: The duly filled application form in the prescribed format (the form is printed in the notice). Attested copies of all educational qualifications (HSLC onwards), experience certificates and other relevant documents. Age proof certificate, and caste proof certificate for SC/ST/OBC candidates. One passport size photograph; the form also asks for a self-attested passport size photograph to be affixed. A No Objection Certificate from the employer, for candidates working in Government/public sector undertakings or autonomous organizations. Original certificates, which are required for verification at the time of reporting. The application form asks for the post applied for, up to two preferred project names, personal and contact details, educational qualifications, details of any contractual obligation to serve Central/State Govt./any other public sector undertaking or autonomous body, language proficiency, computer proficiency and previous work experience. It ends with a declaration that the appointment is liable for termination without notice if material information is found concealed or distorted.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: The walk-in interview starts from 9.30 am. Candidates report between 9.30 am and 10.30 am, submit the application form with copies of their documents, and show the originals for verification. The notice does not describe any other stage.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The posts are purely contractual. Recruitment is temporary and co-terminus with the project and does not guarantee subsequent employment in any Institutes under the Council. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification of the candidate. Applicants should ensure that they satisfy the eligibility criteria. For details, the notice refers to https://www.icfre.gov.in/en/recruitment and https://rfri.icfre.gov.in/vacancy . Contact details printed on the letterhead: phone 0376-2305101/105, e-mail [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. What is the walk-in interview date for ICFRE-RFRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 10 November 2026 from 9.30 am onwards at ICFRE-Rain Forest Research Institute, Jorhat.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time?
faq.answer: Candidates must report between 9.30 am and 10.30 am on the day of the interview, and submit the application form with documents in the same window.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: It is held at ICFRE-Rain Forest Research Institute, Jorhat. The institute's letterhead address is Deovan, Sotai, Jorhat-785010 (Assam).

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 8 posts in total: 4 Junior Project Fellows and 4 Project Assistants.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for JPF and Project Assistant?
faq.answer: JPF needs a first class M. Sc. Degree in Forestry/ Botany/ Ecology/ Life Science/ Geography/ Agriculture. Project Assistant needs a first class Bachelor Degree in Forestry/ Botany/ Zoology/ Geography/ Agriculture.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit as on 01.07.2026 is 28 years for JPF and 25 years for Project Assistant. It is relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST/Women and 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary, and is HRA paid on top?
faq.answer: JPF gets Rs. 24,000/- + HRA as admissible per month. Project Assistant gets Rs. 22,000/- per month (Fixed).

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should I bring?
faq.answer: Bring the filled application form, attested copies of qualification and experience certificates, age and caste proof, one passport size photograph, and a No Objection Certificate if employed in a Government/public sector body or autonomous organization. Originals are needed for verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is the job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely contractual, temporary and co-terminus with the project, which is initially for two months, and they do not guarantee subsequent employment in any Institutes under the Council.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
